title: Three Seasons and One Short Banner
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：league　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 league 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the coach ① joined the league that no player in the stadium would have recorded, and he said the joining was the whole of the season. The ② league, meaning the club itself and not the banner, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a league, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ league in that stadium had the same short banner beside it, and the ④ league at the far stand, meaning the fixture they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A league, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the coach said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the league was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the club. The ⑥ league, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; league, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a club and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ league had become a line in a table, and the table had become an argument about the short banner. The ⑧ league of the whole thing, the coach wrote in September, was one stadium and three seasons of recording; league, he said, is either the fixture at the far stand or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ league I remember is the club recorded in the table, which closed in 1991 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ league, my mother said in 1993, is the only club that improves by being recorded; every league, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like a club. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 联赛；联盟（指球场里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 联赛；联盟（指那个联赛本身，与队旗相对）
C. 固定搭配：join the league 加入这个联赛
D. n. 联赛；联盟（指留给孩子们看的那一轮那一个）
E. n. 赛事之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的联赛之事）
F. n. 联赛；联盟（指积分表里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 荣誉、名次（指一件事里人人都争却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荣誉（抽象总称，指人人都争却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: joined the league that no player in the stadium would have recorded
The league, meaning the club itself and not the banner
the league at the far stand
the league was the whole of the matter
the league had become a line in a table
The league of the whole thing
A league, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: join the league 意为“加入这个联赛”，1984 年那位教头把球场里没有一位球员肯记载的一个联赛做了一遍。
league 意为“联赛；联盟”，指那个联赛本身而不是队旗，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记载。
league 意为“联赛；联盟”，指球场里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一面窄窄的队旗。
league 意为“联赛；联盟”，指最远那排看台留给孩子们看的那一轮那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
league 意为“荣誉、名次”，指一件事里人人都争却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份荣誉就是那件事的全部。
league 意为“荣誉”，指人人都争却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个联赛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
league 意为“联赛；联盟”，指积分表里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1989 年这一个成了积分表里的一行。
league 意为“赛事之事”，教头九月写道，整件事的联赛之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记载。
league 意为“联赛；联盟”，我记得的是积分表里记载过的那一个，1991 年排定了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一个。
league 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，联赛是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的联赛。
